title: Question 10
passage:
Why don’t we call the caterer to confirm the head count?
A. I counted the chairs this morning. B. We can move the dessert table closer to the door. C. Their line is busy. I’ll email the count and ask them to confirm.
passageZh:
我們何不打電話給外燴業者，確認用餐人數？
A. 我今天早上數過椅子了。 B. 我們可以把甜點桌移到靠門一點的地方。 C. 他們的電話忙線。我會用電子郵件寄出人數，請他們確認。
